checks: The original lower hull and [0,2]×Q occupy the two extreme planes of the new coordinate and each has relative (d+1)-dimensional interior. Their hull is full-dimensional. At the two integer layers, the extreme-coordinate equality excludes all contributions from the other layer, giving exactly six positive fibers before padding.

The scale (F/V)^(1/d) gives Q volume F. The three lower fiber volumes are all positive and one equals F, so the total before padding is strictly above 4F. The padding adds only binary sampled layers and multiplies total mass by 2^(n−2), so every fiber is strictly below W/2^n.

Fixing any binary padding vertex and then the new coordinate zero forces the replacement hull on that slice to be exactly the convexified original three enclosing simplices. Consequently both the lower bound for the added volume and the upper bound on the two deficit sums multiply by 2^(n−2). Upper-layer excess is nonnegative and its simplex deficits vanish.
The original a585520b0a2a14db §4 uses Q=(F/V)^(1/d)T and the same strict layer inequality. The archived exact rational verifier includes 72 source, constant and no-heavy checks.
